description: 2 tactical challenges for Black in Noah's Ark Trap. Lure the white queen deep with 8...c5! and trap the b3 bishop.

drills.briefExplanation: 6...Nxd4 7.Nxd4 exd4 8.Qxd4?? c5! 9.Qd5 Be6 — the queen is lured in and the bishop is trapped.
drills.description: Black to play. White retreated 6.Bb3 — start the trap with 6...Nxd4!.
drills.explanation: Noah's Ark: after 6...Nxd4 7.Nxd4 exd4, the natural 8.Qxd4?? walks into 8...c5! — the queen is attacked and must go to d5, where 9...Be6! attacks it again AND seals the b3 bishop's fate. After 10.Qc6+ Bd7 11.Qd5 c4! the bishop on b3 is trapped (its escape squares are gone) and Black wins a piece. The queen and bishop march into the ark two by two.
drills.name: Springing the Ark

drills.briefExplanation: 8...c5 9.Qd5 Be6 10.Qc6+ Bd7 11.Qd5 c4! — chase the queen, then slam the door on the bishop.
drills.description: Black to play. White grabbed with 8.Qxd4?? — spring the trap.
drills.explanation: The execution phase: 8...c5! gains time on the queen, 9...Be6! attacks it a second time while developing, and after 10.Qc6+ Bd7 11.Qd5 the quiet 11...c4! is the point — the b3 bishop's retreats (a2 is occupied, c2 will be covered) vanish, and ...Bc5 next wins it. A trap in two acts: first the queen, then the bishop.
drills.name: Slamming the Door
